exposure: Trial of labor after two Caesarean sections (TOLA2C)
adherence to a specific delivery protocol
previous Caesarean section due to arrested labor
cohort: The cohort consisted of pregnant women who had undergone two previous consecutive Caesarean sections and were planning delivery at a tertiary community hospital between January 2013 and December 2022.
finding: The study found that a trial of labor after two Caesarean sections (TOLA2C) following a specified protocol is safe for mother and fetus, with a 63.0% successful vaginal delivery rate and no major complications.
mod_finding: A trial of labor after two Caesarean sections (TOLA2C) following a specified protocol resulted in a 63.0% successful vaginal delivery rate, with prior vaginal delivery increasing the chance of success and previous CS due to arrested labor increasing the risk of repeat CS.
